name: invisible_playwright_mcp
notes: Installs as a plugin or extension for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI; the standalone web UI calls OpenRouter with the user's key. The tree contains the Python package (MCP server, agent loop, web UI) and an MCP test suite; the browser engine library and fingerprint core are separate repositories, and the engine binary is downloaded from a GitHub release on first start. Its claim of avoiding anti-bot detection and captchas was not tested, and the README asks users to respect site terms. The repository LICENSE is MIT; the README says releases before 2 September 2026 were AGPL-3.0.
summary: MCP server and local web UI that let an LLM drive an anti-detect Firefox build with moving-pointer and key-press input, seeded browser identities, optional proxies and persistent profiles.
